headline: Southern Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Southern (NYSE:SO) reported second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $1.13 per share, up $0.21 from the prior-year period and $0.13 above the company’s estimate, as higher electricity usage, customer growth and construction-related earnings supported results.
